name: bhs-shot-tracker
install: npm ci && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
start: if [ -n "$SHOTS_SUPABASE_URL" ] && [ -n "$SHOTS_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" ]; then node scripts/write-shots-config.js; elif [ ! -f shots-config.js ]; then cp shots-config.example.js shots-config.js; fi

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Static site at http://127.0.0.1:8080. Verify UI in iPhone portrait (390x844).
